Speciality animals do not gain experience. Trained animals, great beasts and familiars follow the animal handling rules of the Animal Emporium.

tables.title: Beast Market
tables.description: Rolled for the beasts on offer.
tables.note: The rule says to roll 2D6 on this table, but the book numbers its six beasts 1 to 6. Speciality animals do not gain experience.

rows.name: Giant Rat
rows.text: 15 warp tokens, Rare 9. M 6, WS 2, BS 0, S 3, T 3, W 1, I 4, A 1, Ld 4. Uses no weapons or armour, gains no experience, and unlike most animals can climb.

rows.name: Skaven Slave
rows.text: 10 warp tokens, Rare 9. M 6, WS 2, BS 2, S 3, T 3, W 1, I 4, A 1, Ld 4. May use the weapons and armour of the warband's Henchmen. Ignored: an out of action slave does not count for Rout tests. Downtrodden: a wounded slave is taken out of action at once, with no injury roll.

rows.name: Wolf Rat
rows.text: 90 warp tokens, Rare 11. M 9, WS 3, BS 0, S 3, T 3, W 1, I 3, A 1, Ld 5. Fights with claws and fangs and uses no weapons or armour. An animal: gains no experience. Frenzy.

rows.name: Spike Jawed Snatcher
rows.text: 25 warp tokens, Rare 10. A weapon: close combat, Strength as user, two-handed. Capture: a model taken out of action by it becomes captured unless the warband... (the rule breaks off in the book).

rows.name: Brood Horror
rows.text: 250 + D6 x 10 gold crowns, Rare 13. M 9, WS 4, BS 0, S 5, T 5, W 3, I 3, A 3, Ld 5. Teeth and claws, unarmed without penalty. Save: an unmodifiable 5+. Causes fear. Climbs. Ravenous Monstrosity: if it caused at least 1 wound last round it regenerates 1 wound. Mount: a Skaven Hero with the right skill may ride it.

rows.name: Hellpit Abomination
rows.text: 300 + D6 x 10 warp tokens, Rare 15. M 2D6, WS 3, BS 0, S 5, T 5, W 3, I 2, A 4, Ld 6. Large, fear, Great Beast, Staggered But Not Down. Save: an unmodifiable 5+. Too Many Heads!: never stunned, counting stunned as knocked down. Regeneration: when wounded, roll a D6, and on a 4+ it heals every wound it has suffered; fire and magical attacks prevent this. Warpstone Spikes: wizards within 12" are at -2 to their magic rolls. Too Horrible to Die: the first time it is slain each game, roll a D6 on the Too Horrible to Die table.

chart.title: Too Horrible to Die
chart.description: Rolled the first time the Hellpit Abomination is slain in a game.

rows.name: Out of Action.
rows.text: It is taken out of action.

rows.name: The Rats Emerge!
rows.text: D6 Giant Rats burst out of it, and it is taken out of action as normal.

rows.name: It's Alive!
rows.text: It recovers D3 wounds.

locations.name: Eshin Assassination Contract
locations.rules:
Pay Clan Eshin 60 warp tokens to put out a contract. In the next round choose any one game for the Assassin to appear in, even one your warband does not play, and choose his target there: he gets +1 to hit and must always move towards it.

The Assassin is a Night Runner: M 6, WS 4, BS 4, S 4, T 3, W 1, I 6, A 2, Ld 7, with fighting claws and throwing stars coated in black lotus, and a Thief's Cloak. Art of Silent Death: he fights barehanded without penalty, counting as having two weapons (+1 Attack), and causes a critical hit on a to wound roll of 5-6; with Eshin fighting claws it gives +2 Attacks rather than +1.

A Clan Eshin warband may send one of its own Heroes instead, still paying the 60 warp tokens; he misses your warband's game to appear in the chosen one. A warband with the Assassination Protocol campaign point bonus may send one of its Heroes along with the Assassin, or a Clan Eshin warband two Heroes and no Assassin.

locations.name: The Plague Cauldrons
locations.rules:
A Skaven may choose a disease from the Plague Cauldrons table and roll for its rarity. If it is not found he may order it from the Plague Monks, adding +1 to the rarity roll for each earlier visit when he comes back to check. Or a Plague Monk of the warband may stay to finish it, missing the next battle, and it is ready for the next game.

Each disease comes in a sealed vial, thrown in the shooting phase as holy water is, to twice the thrower's Strength in inches. It only takes hold on a model that has already suffered a wound in the battle. On a to hit roll of 1 the thrower drops it on himself and is infected at once, wounded or not.

The Plague Monks also sell Skalm for 30 warp tokens, a smear that heals a warrior of the wounds he has suffered in a game. Clan Pestilens sell any amount of Black Lotus, Dark Venom, Manticore Spore and Spider Spittle with no rarity roll, at 10 warp tokens a vial more than the usual price.

tables.title: Plague Cauldrons
tables.description: The diseases on sale.

rows.text: 60 warp tokens, Rare 12. -1 Strength and -1 Toughness until cured with Man Bane (Herbs and Potions table, Herbalist). Roll a D6 after each battle: on a 1 he passes it to another random model of the warband.
100 warp tokens, Rare 13. A Leadership test before each battle; on a failure he misses it to recover, and on a double he passes it to another random warrior of the warband.

120 warp tokens, Rare 13. An Initiative test after each battle; on a failure his Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill drops by 1. With one of them at 0 he is blind in one eye; with both at 0 he is blind, and is struck from the roster or left in camp until cured. The only cure is washing the eyes with Valerian Tea (Elixir, Herbs and Potions table, Herbalist).

100 + D6 x 10 warp tokens, Rare 14. At once -1 Movement and +1 Toughness, and again at the end of each game unless he passes a Strength test. At Movement 0 he has turned to stone: strike him from the roster. Roll a D6 after each battle: on a 1 he passes it to another random model of the warband.

150 + D6 x 10 warp tokens, Rare 15. Mark it on the roster. Before each battle he must pass a Toughness test or lose 1 Toughness for good, dying at 0. On a roll of 6 for the test he passes it to a random member of the warband: mark it on the roster too.

locations.name: Ektrit Warmachine Workshop
locations.rules:
For the right price warbands may buy smaller versions of the Skaven war machines on the Ektrit Warmachine Workshop table. The book gives each a price and rarity and no other way of buying it.

Skaven carts have no draft animals: a Warp Engine moves one, or it is pushed, 1" for each Skaven or giant rat pushing (4 pushing move it 4"). A Skaven pushing does nothing else that turn. A Draft Animal hit on the hit location table hits a random Skaven pushing the cart.

tables.title: Ektrit Warmachine Workshop
tables.description: The war machines on sale.

rows.text: 150 warp tokens, Rare 12, ships only. The ship moves 2" more a turn.

250 warp tokens, Rare 13. A cart needs no draft animals, and a boat moves 4" more a turn. Hits on the mast or draft animals hit the engine instead, which has 4 wounds and Toughness 8. Refuel: D3 wyrdstone a game.

220 warp tokens, Rare 13. Range 36", Strength 5 (+1 Strength and injury against armoured enemies). Refuel: D3 warpstone a game. Huge: it takes 4 crew spaces on a boat or cart, leaving a cart only 2, for the driver and the operator. Charge up: it needs a turn to charge and so fires only every second turn if it moved the turn before. Jolt: roll to hit with the firer's Ballistic Skill; the first model hit takes a Strength 5 hit, then on a D6 roll of 4+ it leaps to a random warrior within 4" at Strength 3, and so on at -1 Strength each time, until it misses or reaches 0.

250 warp tokens, Rare 14. Range 24", Strength D3 x 5. Great Censer: in the shooting phase the driver may loose the censer, rolling to hit with his Ballistic Skill; a miss scatters it 6" in a random direction. Every model under the small blast template where it lands takes D3 Strength 5 hits, and from then on the fumes come from that spot rather than the cart. Poisonous Fumes: every model within 3" of the censer ball, on the cart or loosed, must pass a Toughness test at the end of the turn or lose a wound; models immune to poison are not affected. Defend the Ball!: if its warband routs with the ball loose, the ball is lost; a new one costs 100 warp tokens. Huge: it takes 4 crew spaces, leaving a cart only 2 (the book heads this rule with the Screaming Bell's name).

200 warp tokens, Rare 14. Peal of Doom: no spell may be cast within 12" of it, and a spell in effect that comes within 12" ends; Magic of the Horned Rat is exempt. The Bell tolls 13!: if a game reaches turn 13 with no winner, the Skaven side with the bell wins the scenario. Huge: it takes 4 crew spaces, leaving a cart only 2.

locations.name: Skurvy Dockyards
locations.rules: Skaven may buy any item of the Craftsmarket that is not limited to one race, as well as the items listed below it in the book (presumably the Ektrit Warmachine Workshop's, printed beside it; the book does not say), ordering them as the Cartwright and Shipwright describe.

locations.name: Clan Grutnick Warpstone Mine
locations.rules:
For the price of 1 of the warpstone found, Clan Grutnick lets any number of Heroes and slaves mine. Roll a D6 for each Hero and slave, and read the total on the exploration chart for the warpstone found (presumably its income chart).

A Hero who rolls a 1 must pass a Toughness test or miss the next game. A captured warrior or slave who rolls a 1 breaks free and returns to his own warband as a Hero: a Henchman counts as rolling The Lad's Got Talent, and the Hero gains D6+2 experience. One who rolls a 6 is worked to death. Either way he is struck from the Skaven player's roster.

The book says Grutnick will let anyone mine for a price, though the Undercity is closed to all but Skaven.
